title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1, section 3 (Delkatla)
heading: Delkatla
sourceText:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Delkatla
3 That portion of the Province, in the vicinity of the Village of Massett, that is within the following boundaries: All land and water contained within District Lots 7, 7A and 11 (except those portions included in Plans 946, 946A, 946B, 5574, 7450 and 7466), Queen Charlotte Land District.
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
